steps.title: Boil the water
steps.instruction: Heat 350 g of water to just off the boil, around 96 degrees C.

steps.title: Rinse the filter
steps.instruction: Set a paper filter in the dripper and rinse it with hot water, then discard the rinse water.

steps.title: Add the grounds
steps.instruction: Add 22 g of medium-fine ground coffee to the filter and shake gently to level the bed.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.instruction: Pour 50 g of water over the grounds in a spiral. Wait 30 seconds while it bubbles and releases gas.

steps.title: Pour in stages
steps.instruction: Pour the remaining water in two or three slow spirals, keeping the bed level, until you reach 350 g total.

steps.title: Wait for drawdown
steps.instruction: Let the water fully drain through. Total brew time should land around 2:30 to 3:00.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Remove the dripper and pour. Best sipped within the next few minutes.
